name: tailcat
description: like netcat, but over Tailscale's data plane, without Tailscale's control plane
one_liner: A simple point-to-point encrypted data-transfer tool that piggybacks on Tailscale's network, without needing a full Tailscale account.
buyer: Honestly a sysadmin/developer tool — not something with a clear non-technical buyer.
business_use_cases: A sysadmin uses it for quick, secure file transfers between two servers without setting up a full VPN.
A managed-IT provider bundles it into their toolkit for secure ad-hoc client support sessions.
A DevOps consultancy uses it during incident response to move data securely between machines fast.

money_ideas.idea: Offer it as a feature inside a broader 'secure remote support' service package for an MSP's paid support tier.

steal_this: Not a consumer product — at best, add it as a feature bullet in an MSP's existing secure-remote-support offering.
